test_title: PYST 44: SSC CPO - English Comprehension (Held on 9 Nov 2022 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.

Ms. Suma was a bit apprehensive about doing so much in just one day, but it was all __plain sailing__.
solution:
The correct answer is Very easy.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The most appropriate option to substitute 'plain sailing' is 'very easy'.
 
• Plain sailing: Smooth and easy progress.
 
 
• Example: We know it won't be plain sailing because there are no easy games at this level. 
 
 
 
• Therefore, as per the points mentioned above option option 2 is the correct answer.

 

Correct sentence: *Ms. Suma was a bit apprehensive about doing so much in just one day, but it was all very easy__.*
